en: US markets were closed on Saturday, September 5, 2026, so there is no new session to report: the last one, September 4, 2026, was covered in the previous edition and its numbers are not repeated here. This edition reads instead the 89 stories published since then by 15 outlets we track, and brings forward the 24 that matter most.

Leading the weekend coverage: The Wall Street Journal reports: “How Billions in Iranian Money Passes Through U.S. Banks”; MarketWatch reports: “7% mortgage rates are already here, some buyers and mortgage experts say”; MarketWatch reports: “Jobs and Iran add to Trump’s midterm headaches. Why that’s good for bonds and bad for energy stocks.”.
By theme: Markets and macro (61), Crypto (8), Tech (7), Italy (8).

What did trade while the exchanges were shut, measured from Friday's US close: Solana +4.29%; Ethereum +2.27%; XRP +1.61%. These are the only market moves in this edition — they are quotes, not forecasts.

Per tema: Mercati e macro (61), Crypto (8), Tech (7), Italia (8).
